entra a su apartamento de Bogotá: comes into his flat in Bogotá
con la chaqueta cerrada y abultada: with his jacket zipped up and bulging
Su hermana Marina levanta la vista del s: His sister Marina looks up from the sofa
por qué traes la chaqueta así: why is your jacket like that
pero no te enojes conmigo: but do not be angry with me
Adentro hay un perrito pequeño: Inside there is a small puppy
No podemos tener un perro aquí: We cannot have a dog here
El edificio no lo permite: The building does not allow it
pero estaba solo bajo la lluvia: but he was alone in the rain
Y lo trajiste sin preguntarme nada: And you brought him without asking me
Mamá nos va a matar a los dos: Mum is going to kill us both
Le pongo cara de pena: I will give her the sad face
A mí no me metas en tus líos: Do not drag me into your messes
Querías dejarlo ahí: Would you have left him there
mírale esa cara de susto que tiene: look at that frightened face of his
Sabía que tú también tienes buen corazón: I knew you had a good heart too
Mañana buscamos a su dueño o una solució: Tomorrow we look for his owner or a solution
ya se encariñó contigo: he has grown fond of you already
Y mamá llega el domingo a visitarnos: And Mum comes to visit on Sunday
Entonces tenemos dos días para esconderl: Then we have two days to hide him
